consequence.statement: Environments that do not configure nodePort.addresses will continue to use the default behavior of exposing NodePort services on the first suitable IPv4 and IPv6 address of each device; environments that set nodePort.addresses can now customize which IP addresses are used for NodePort load-balancing.

assertion.statement: The Helm value `nodePort.addresses` was added to configure which IP addresses expose NodePort services; previously Cilium used only the first suitable IPv4 and IPv6 address per device.
